translations.web: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
translations.bsb: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
translations.kjv: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
translations.asv: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
